answer: Entering an orchard costs a base fee plus a convex surcharge keyed to the delta between its largest cluster's share and a diversity cap. A farm seeding 800 clones into one orchard pays quadratic: every join lifts the price under its siblings, while an honest agent in slack demand pays near zero. Sponsors stake liability, so one whisper of collusion triggers a graft audit, uprooting the block and burning every bond. Honest orchards ration caps, so farms cannot pool admission: each extra clone must outbid members for shrinking slack or scatter wide, each demanding sureties it cannot fabricate.
